CREATE TABLE customers (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    emial TEXT NOT NULL

It goes in a new migration file, `migrations/0008_add_customer_phone.sql`. Don't edit `0007_add_customers.sql`. A project memory says files in `migrations/` are already applied in production, so they must never be edited.

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN phone TEXT;
```

I made the column nullable because existing rows have no phone number. If you want `NOT NULL`, add a `DEFAULT` too.

`0007` has a typo: the column is `emial`, not `email`. The same rule applies, so I wouldn't fix it in place. You could fix it in a later migration with `ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;`. That's a separate change, and I haven't made it.
